All In All Gift Box by Atyab Al Marshoud is the ultimate luxurious and sophisticated gift set, featuring three captivating hair mists with exquisite fragrances.

Each fragrance is a masterpiece of oriental elegance, blending notes of oud, amber, musk, and florals for a truly mesmerizing olfactory experience. Perfect for gifting or indulging yourself, this collection embodies sophistication and the rich essence of Arabian heritage.

Presented in a beautifully designed gift box, it is the perfect way to celebrate any special occasion.

An alluring hair mist featuring the captivating scents of oud, patchouli, jasmine, and fruity raspberry. A luxurious fragrance that leaves your hair delicately scented throughout the day.

Indulge in the soothing and uplifting scents of Khisla Violet, a hair mist combining the relaxing aroma of lavender, delicate floral notes of jasmine, and the warm, spicy undertones of cardamom.

Heart Notes: Jasmine, Lily, Violet, Lavender, Rose, Cardamom
Base Notes: White Musk, Cedarwood, Amber, Iris, Vanilla

Khisla All In All Hair Mist — 50ml

An exquisite hair mist featuring a precious blend of signature Khisla scents. A refined combination of raspberry, patchouli, musk, and pink pepper creates a luxurious fragrance that leaves your hair delicately scented throughout the day.
